svg.title: UMEI — bimanual assembly wordmark / v5 / seamless gold i
svg.desc: Editable vector revision based on the supplied reference. UM is retained unchanged from v2. The EI group is translated 19 units left. Both grippers use identical 34-by-8 fingers, 8-unit palm thickness, and 30-unit inner reach; their jaw openings are 36 and 20. The lower shoulder-to-wrist span is 52 units versus 71 above. Three ring joints share x=424 in EI-local coordinates, at y=20,76,132. All joint holes and eye holes are true transparent cutouts. The entire i is gold. No raster images or fonts are embedded. The UM ligature is the prior reference redraw, not an official master asset. In v5, only the gold stem and base are combined into one continuous path to remove the shared-edge rendering seam; all other artwork, dimensions, colors, and positions are unchanged.

g.inkscape:label: 03 E — spine and three aligned ring joints
05 E / square head and two small eyes
09 i / unified gold stem and base — seamless outline
10 i / enlarged gold dot aligned with upper arm
